assets.title: Übersicht
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a meticulously art-directed, high-fidelity, flat straight-on desktop web application screenshot for LIEUVA Agentenzentrale, a LOCAL single-user agent control dashboard. German UI. Target 1920x1200 landscape, extraordinarily crisp typography, beautiful spacing, high contrast and realistic working software. Fill the canvas with UI, no physical laptop, no browser chrome, no perspective, no stock photos, no robots, no random charts. A discreet label 'ENTWURF · BEISPIELDATEN' always visible. Persistent six-item navigation: Übersicht, Agenten, Vorschläge, Läufe, Zusammenspiel, Einstellungen. LIEUVA brand top left; status 'Lokal verbunden'. Six specialist agents plus ONE Master (seven total); roles: Qualität & Risiken, UX, Produktstrategie, Markt, SEO / GEO, 3D & Blender. Preserve this concept's design language across all screens.
